### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for very young toddlers?**
A: While it is designed for preschoolers, activities are best suited for children who have developed basic fine motor skills. For the youngest toddlers, parental guidance will be necessary to help them navigate the concepts and tasks within the book.

**Q: Does the Montessori method focus only on anatomy?**
A: No. The Montessori approach covers many areas of early childhood development, including language, practical life skills, and sensorial learning. This specific activity book focuses its curriculum on human anatomy as part of that broader educational spectrum.
